title: mime-tree: add tests for QP false-truncation, octet-stream walk, and solo begin-base64 scan
description: Three test gaps: (1) QP decode where 4x pre-truncation overshoots — decoded output fits within max_bytes but is_truncated is incorrectly true; (2) walk.rs: application/octet-stream without Content-Disposition: attachment should land in attachments; (3) uuencode.rs: scan_inline_uuencode on a body with only a begin-base64 block (no valid UU block) should return one error item.
